nary_nodes.label: Brenda Fricker dies
evidence: Brenda Fricker, the Irish actor who won an Academy Award for 1989's "My Left Foot," played the Pigeon Lady in "Home Alone 2" and appeared in "A Time to Kill" and "So I Married an Axe Murderer," has died, her agent confirmed to CBS News on Friday.
Fricker died Thursday night in Dublin after "a period of ill health," her agent, Phil Belfield, said in a statement to CBS News.

nary_nodes.label: Fricker wins Oscar
evidence: Fricker won the Oscar for best supporting actress for her performance in 1989's "My Left Foot," about the Irish writer Christy Brown, who was born with cerebral palsy and only had control over his left foot.
Fricker's victory in Hollywood marked the first time an Irish woman won an Oscar.
